text:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: Incident detected — Datadog ingestion delay (metrics + traces). Multiple dashboards reporting stale data and gaps. Auto-escalation to SRE oncall.

maria: I can confirm. Host metrics for inference-prod are stuck at T-5m. Trace spans not arriving. Dashboards show 90% of recent writes queued in dd-ingest.

jamal: I'm on call, taking this. paging @maria @kevin. First goal: confirm customer-facing impact, then activate fallbacks.

kevin: Looks like dd-agent from our side is still pushing, but Datadog's intake is returning 503/429 intermittently. I can see retries piling on the agents.

sophie: Support: no incoming customer tickets yet, but proactively preparing a status update. If observability is blind, customers might open cases shortly.

maria: Quick checks done:
- internal health endpoints (local exporter) show normal CPU/RPS
- prometheus host metrics still present (scrape OK) -> metrics live inside cluster but not in Datadog
- traces from our app are buffered in agent directories (/var/lib/datadog/queue)

jamal: Mitigation plan (short):
1) Flip alerting to Prometheus/CloudWatch fallbacks for critical SLOs.
2) Reduce dd-agent retry rate and enable local persistence to avoid OOMs (prevent agent thrash).
3) Start shipping critical logs/traces to our alternate observability (CloudWatch + S3) for retention.
4) Reach out to Datadog support + track status.datadoghq.com.

kevin: Commands I'm running now:
```bash
# switch prometheus alerts to active (one-off)
kubectl apply -f /runbooks/fallback/prometheus-alerts-manual.yaml

# tail local dd queue for evidence
sudo ls -lah /var/lib/datadog/queue || true
sudo tail -n 200 /var/log/datadog/agent.log | sed -n '1,200p'
```

maria: I'm reducing sampling on APM at the agent level to cut throughput: setting DD_TRACE_SAMPLE_RATE=0.1 on inference-prod can buy headroom. I'll push the env change via k8s patch.

jamal: Oncall notes: assigning severity P1 due to observability blindspot during active anomalies. Customer-impact assessment: API endpoints still responding, but metrics-backed alerts may be delayed and autoscaling could fail if metrics are missing. Marking potential risk to throughput autoscale.

ops-bot: @jamal acknowledged. Incident channel created and pinned.

datadog-bot: Datadog status: partial outage in US intake reported (https://status.datadoghq.com/) — ingestion delays acknowledged. Support ticket created (case #DD-83421) by kevin.

kevin: Update from support: they're currently throttling some intake due to a regional backend replication issue. CS asked for customer manifests and agent logs; they requested a sample agent log tarball. I'm preparing it now.

sophie: Drafting status message for customers: short note describing delayed alerts/graphs and that we're investigating. Will hold for confirmation of impact.

maria: Temporary runbook changes applied:
- Prometheus alerts enabled for infra-critical dashboards
- APM sampling lowered to 10%
- Increased local log retention and started an rsync to S3 for critical logs:
```bash
# quick rsync for critical logs
rsync -avz /var/log/app/critical/ s3://redwood-incident-archive/datadog-fallback/$(date +%s)/
```

jamal: For any ongoing incident responses: assume Datadog metrics/traces are delayed by up to 20 mins. Rely on Prometheus/CloudWatch for real-time scaling decisions. Ops: update any playbooks that read from DD for autoscale triggers.

kevin: I'm also enabling host-level exporters on a few canary nodes and adding direct prometheus scrape targets for the inference tier so dashboards reflect live CPU/RPS immediately.

sophie: Customer comms ready. Proposed text: "We're seeing a Datadog ingestion delay affecting some dashboards and alerts. Our services remain operational; our engineers are actively mitigating and using alternate monitoring. We'll update at least every 30 minutes." Approve?

maria: Approved. Sophie, send out and paste link here.

sophie: Posted to status.redwood.com and sent to CSM + SOC. Link: https://status.redwood.com/incidents/2033456789 (internal tracking).

datadog-bot: Support updated: they've prioritized our case; estimated recovery ETA ~ +30-45m but subject to change.

jamal: Handoff: I'm on until 22:00 PT. If anything degrades (increased error rates, autoscale failures), escalate to eng-runtime (@kevin) and bring on infra lead.

maria: Capturing post-incident actions:
- Add a dedicated Datadog fallback in our routing rules (automatic failover to Prometheus for critical alerts).
- Add runbook step to reduce dd-agent throughput automatically on global ingestion issues.
- Evaluate using multi-sink APM to avoid single vendor blindspots.
- Postmortem owner: jamal.

kevin: Data collection note: please gather: agent.log, dd-agent config, local queue sizes, prometheus scrape samples, and a list of alerts that fired late. I'll upload to the incident folder.

sophie: Notifying affected enterprise customers via the CSM rotation list, highlighting mitigation and ETA.

ops-bot: :white_check_mark: Datadog ingestion showing improvement — some metrics trickling back. Continue monitoring.

maria: I'm seeing metrics return on a subset of dashboards. Not yet complete, watch for delayed spikes.

datadog-bot: Datadog: incident resolved by upstream; final notice posted.

jamal: Closing notes: switching to monitoring mode. No customer-facing downtime observed, but observability delay is unacceptable. Postmortem scheduled tomorrow 10:00 PT. Action items assigned in postmortem doc.

kevin: I'll follow up with a proposal for multi-sink APM/metrics and auto-fallback wiring.

sophie: I'll send the customer follow-up update summarizing timeline and actions.

maria: Thanks team. Good job moving to fallbacks quickly.

ops-bot: Channel archived to incidents after handoff.
